name: Single-Arm Machine Chest Press
description: The Single-Arm Machine Chest Press performs a unilateral pressing movement using one arm at a time on a plate-loaded or selectorized chest press machine. This variation corrects strength imbalances between sides, creates an anti-rotation core demand, and allows the working arm's pectoral to be trained through its full active range without the limitation of the weaker arm.

execution.starting_position: Sit in the chest press machine. Grip one handle at chest level. The other arm can hold the frame of the machine for stability.
execution.setup_instructions: If the machine has independent arms, use one arm. Set the seat and handle position as normal. The stationary arm grips the machine frame, not the other handle.
steps: Step 1: Press one arm forward to full extension.
Step 2: Return to starting position under control.
Step 3: Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
Step 4: Resist the rotation created by the unilateral load — keep torso square.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on each press. Inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Rotating the torso toward the pressing arm
Using a machine that does not allow independent arm movement
safety_considerations: Only perform on machines with independent arm mechanisms
Use a significantly lighter load than your bilateral press
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension; full return to deep stretch on working side.
coaching_cues: Fight the rotation — keep both hips and shoulders square
Feel the working pec from stretch to squeeze
